name: CrankWheel Screen Sharing
description:
Share screen with your customer as easily as you make a phone call. Viewers never need to install any software, even on mobile. Let your customer remote control your screen to "kick the tires" if needed, or fill in forms.

Record your meetings or create screencasts or webcam captures, with cloud video storage. Easily share recordings as a link, or as an animated preview in your sales emails.

Increase sales with the ability to add a visual explanation without preparation, or to easily book a meeting in advance.

Other features:
- Easy screen sharing
- Viewer engagement alert
- Screen recorder
- Play back HQ videos with sound in a session
- Redirect viewers to your landing page post session
- Lead capture widget

CrankWheel is free for limited commercial use for any number of users hosting up to 15 meetings per month, with enterprise-class features such as single sign-on (SSO), custom domains, white labelling, audit logging and CRM integration available on paid plans.

We use the data we collect only to improve our screensharing services to benefit our users. Only for those enterprise customers that opt in to the optional audit log or content filter features, we collect browsing history while screen sharing to enable these features. Also, only for accounts that specifically opt into sending us crash reports for diagnostic purposes, we collect crash reports using a 3rd party provider named Sentry, and such crash reports could potentially include personal data. Read our full privacy policy at https://crankwheel.com/privacy-policy/
